verdict.rationale: OpenAI publishes an official, maintained Cookbook described as a worked-examples library of practical code examples and patterns across APIs, agents, evals, multimodal applications, and integrations, which a developer can adapt. That breadth implies application-level examples rather than single calls, but the evidence never explicitly shows a full end-to-end walkthrough. missing for 10: explicit evidence that cookbook entries are complete end-to-end tasks rather than snippets, independent or hands-on corroboration of the examples' quality and adaptability.

support.subject: As a developer, official cookbooks or worked examples show real end-to-end tasks — not just single-call snippets — that I can adapt
